content.short: Intersect is a member-based Cardano organization focused on ecosystem coordination, governance, and long-term stewardship.
content.description: Intersect is a member-based organization created to coordinate collaboration, governance participation, and long-term stewardship across the Cardano ecosystem. It brings together builders, operators, enterprises, and community contributors to discuss priorities, shape working groups, and support the maintenance and future direction of Cardano. Through member participation, committees, and ecosystem programs, Intersect provides structured coordination around proposals, collaboration, and shared decision-making.
content.meta: Intersect is a member-based Cardano organization focused on governance, coordination, and ecosystem stewardship. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Who's Standing in the 2026 Constitutional Committee Election?
resources.tldr: Ten candidates for four seats, voted by DReps on a stake-weighted basis. The committee reviews governance actions for constitutional compliance, and cannot vote on their merits.

resources.title: Cardano Upgrade: The van Rossem Hard Fork
resources.tldr: A hard fork is months of testing, coordination, governance debate and infrastructure work before the switch is thrown; this one enacted 18 July 2026. Strong on the process behind the headline.

resources.title: Lowering minPoolCost and Increasing Smart Contract Capacity
resources.tldr: One governance action bundling two changes: cutting minPoolCost to 75 ada and raising Plutus execution limits. Written so stake pool operators and DReps can vote knowing what actually moves.
